Ari (PM): kicking off a short thread to lock launch gates for tenant-islands (routing + multi-region isolation). need minimal but testable criteria we can give customers.
Ben (Eng): propose three axes: latency SLO, isolation guarantee (billing/compute), and fallback semantics. each needs measurable gates.
Tara (Infra): practical infra gates: autoscaler <60s on 2x load, placement label enforcement, and egress cost delta estimate accepted by customer.
Raj (SRE): ops gates: canary plan (1% for 48h, 10% for 7d), alerting (P95, error-rate), runbook tabletop complete.
Maya (Sales): customers want clear migration windows and rollback guarantees. propose pilot contracts (no SLA) and reserved contracts (SLA w/ credits).
Ben (Eng): runtime gate: KV cache hit >=80% for steady state pilot, batching tail below target, compatibility tag for model variants.
Ari (PM): timeline: owners post 1-paragraph plans by Thu. I'll synthesize canvas and share with GTM.
Tara (Infra): will run quick egress calc + scheduler notes (2w).
Raj (SRE): will draft canary runbook and alert thresholds (1w).
NotifyBot: created ticket PLAT-5100 "island-onramp-gating" and scheduled follow-up Tue 10:00.
Ari (PM): thanks—post any customer-specific constraints here and i'll fold into the legal handoff.
